=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:569-570 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The branch_runs filter admits internal-review.yml push runs as bound PR reviews; a successful no-op push run can be selected as the latest review and allow auto-merge despite a failed real review.
  WHY: In .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:22-24, pushes to claude/** branches trigger the workflow on push events in addition to pull_request events. When an open pull request already exists, resolve-claude-branch-pr outputs proceed=false and exits 0 (lines 158-167), skipping the review job and completing the workflow run with conclusion "success". Because line 570 only checks run.get("event") != "workflow_dispatch", this no-op push run is treated as a valid bound review of the PR. If a real review run (such as the parallel pull_request event run) failed, but the push event run received a higher Actions run ID or ran on a subsequent push to the branch, max(newer, key=lambda run: run["id"]) selects the push run as the latest review. Since its conclusion is "success", check_review_runs() returns None instead of review_superseded, allowing evaluate() to enable auto-merge on a PR whose actual review failed. Only runs with run.get("event") == "pull_request" should be admitted from branch_runs as bound PR reviews.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

  WHY: scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:569-570 includes every matching head-branch run except `workflow_dispatch` as a bound review. In `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml:138-156,172,182-194`, failed PR lookups are treated as “no PR” and the push route proceeds to the no-PR review. `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:591-609` runs that route as reviewer-panel and commit-comment-only. When the PR lookup fails through the grace window, a successful `push` run can become the latest bound review, masking a newer failed PR review; the pending-checks evaluator can then enable auto-merge using the older marker.
